method: Open each imported app, verify package id and URL on its detail screen, inspect Android UI Automator switch nodes throughout its actual additional-options form, and compare checked states against imported values. The first two apps were scrolled at 420 dpi; subsequent forms fit together at temporary 120 dpi. Original density restored after inspection.
